message.content: {"caption":"Two example task-execution traces show an agent using retrieved skills to complete shopping and household tasks.","description":"Two side-by-side, interface-like text panels are headed “WebShop” and “ALFWorld.” The WebShop panel shows a request to find a navy-blue women’s button-down shirt under $40, retrieved apparel skills, and reasoning steps that select a product and initiate a purchase. The ALFWorld panel shows a request to heat an egg, retrieved heat-task skills, and steps directing the agent to place the egg in a microwave and then on a countertop. Both traces end with a green check mark.","figure_type":"screenshot","chart_values":[]}
